title.zh: 【万事达卡推出稳定币支付风险评估服务 Stablecoin Security】
title.en: 【万事达卡推出稳定币支付风险评估服务 Stablecoin Security】

current_state.zh: Mastercard introduced Stablecoin Security, an API-delivered service that scores the source of funds, transaction context and fraud/sanctions risk of stablecoin transfers before they settle on-chain, with Borderless and Keyrails as first partners and a North America launch ahead of global commercial rollout in 2027, when acquired infrastructure provider BVNK will be integrated.
